title: spec: `PageTypeSchema` says `home` is "the platform-level landing page" and `utility` a "floating utility panel", but the landing is the first navigation item and both types render as ordinary inline pages
body:
Ruled: 6190536588 · letter Q1 A · Q2 A · 2026-10-15T11:06Z

Filing gate ①: a `finding`, class c (a declared contract the runtime does not honour, at a spec → renderer seam), with a named real producer.
`reach:` named producer: HotCRM `src/sales/pages/home.page.ts` (`sales_home_page`, `type: 'home'`, `isDefault: true`) and `src/sales/pages/utility_bar.page.ts` (`utility_bar_page`, `type: 'utility'`), on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.1. Measured by the `repo:hotcrm` seat's dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 5 (report comment `6184527028`): `sales_home_page` is served with `isDefault: true` by `GET /api/v1/meta/page/sales_home_page`, yet no member lands on it; `utility_bar_page` renders in the main column, `position: static`. `pnpm validate` exits 0 with no word on either.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01P8mZuzuyZAHSrgQKmv6ASv`). The seat re-read the spec on objectstack `origin/main` `8d05456cb` and the renderer on objectui `origin/main` `7c13d30`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: objectstack triage, then the lane that owns `packages/spec/src/ui` (with objectui's `packages/components` page renderer).
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open + closed):
- "PageTypeSchema home landing page utility floating panel renders inline page type declared not honoured" → 2 hits, #20101 (the `type` default not reaching consumers) and #17232 (repeater titles), both closed and different.
- "utility page type floating utility bar slot console shell" → 0 hits.

## The contradiction, in the spec itself

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` `PageTypeSchema` (L806-815): `'home', // Platform-level home/landing page` and `'utility', // Floating utility panel (e.g. notes, phone dialer)`. The doc block above it (L786-791) adds "`home` is the platform-level landing page (tab landing) … Use `home` for app-level landing" and "`utility` is a floating utility panel".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` `HOME_PAGE_ID_RETIRED` (L1363-1371): "An app's landing page IS its first navigation item (by `order`) … to change where an app opens, reorder `navigation` so the intended entry is first". That is what the console does (objectui `AppContent.tsx` `resolveLandingRoute` → `findFirstRoute`, which never reads a page's `type`).
- `PageSchema.isDefault` (page.zod.ts L1673-1678) is defined for record pages only; on any other page it is "outside this rule", so a `home` page's `isDefault: true` is accepted, stored, served and read by nothing.

## The renderer

objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` L500-522: `HomePageLayout`, `AppPageLayout` and `UtilityPageLayout` are the same function, `RegionLayout` with a different `pageType` (width only). Nothing floats, and the console has no shell slot that hosts a `utility` page.

## Why it matters

An author, human or AI, reading the enum writes `type: 'home'` (+ `isDefault`) to make a landing page and `type: 'utility'` to make a floating bar. Both validate, and neither does what the spec says. HotCRM shipped exactly that, and those pages had no UI path until objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2117.

## Expected (the owning lane decides which)

The two comments describe what the runtime does: `home` is a wide region page, and the landing is the first navigation item. Or the runtime honours them: a `utility` shell slot, and a declared landing. ADR-0049's enforce-or-remove rule applies to the PROMISE as much as to the enum value. A `home` page's `isDefault` is either given a meaning or refused at validate.

## Acceptance

No spec text promises a landing or a floating panel that the console does not deliver; `os validate` says something, or the runtime acts, when a non-record page sets `isDefault: true`.
